name: Business 2 Community

sources.title: Business2Community — live business/marketing news site ('500K+ monthly readers', '1K+ articles'); contributor model ('we only work with the best writers… carefully vetted'); Contact Us and Editors links in footer

requirements: Contributor/earned-editorial model — historically a community-contributed article platform; the current site frames writers as 'carefully vetted' experts
No self-serve submit page on the current homepage — contributor applications go through Contact Us / the editorial team
Content remit: business news, marketing, small business, AI — plus a conspicuous crypto/affiliate content layer
preparation: A contributed-article pitch in business/marketing/tech aimed at SMB readers
Writing samples for the contributor vetting
workflow: Contact the editorial team via the footer Contact Us page to apply as a contributor
Alternatively pitch a story angle to the Editors
If accepted, articles are published under your byline — B2C is a bylined-article model
watchFor: The site mixes editorial with aggressive affiliate/crypto content ('Best Crypto', 'Bitcoin Casino') — brand-adjacency risk
Historically an open contributor platform; the current vetting bar and whether new contributors are still onboarded is unclear
A pure product-announcement post is unlikely to be accepted — thought-leadership framing required
countsAsLive: A bylined article is published at business2community.com
unknowns: Whether new-contributor applications are still open and what the criteria are
